Hymn 115: Come, Ye Disconsolate
Time Signature: 4/4
Musical Key: E-flat Major
Composer: Samuel Webbe
Lyricist/Text Author: Thomas Moore
Category: Prayer and Supplication

This is hymn number 115 titled "Come, Ye Disconsolate" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in E-flat Major with a 4/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by Samuel Webbe and the lyrics were written by Thomas Moore.
This hymn is categorized under: Prayer and Supplication.
